---
title: "Buttonwood Makes a Virtue of Necessity"
date: "2005-11-16"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

*The Economist’s* outgoing [Buttonwood columnist](http://www.economist.com/agenda/displaystory.cfm?story_id=5163772 "Buttonwood columnist") tells her readers that money doesn’t matter after all, welcome news for any readers who might have actually read Buttonwood for investment advice rather than for the pointless personal anecdotes.
